subtitle: Find out why the other bank went dark.
briefing: The lantern across the river has gone out, and the ferry is closed. The villagers have sent a patrol to find out what happened. Reach the ferryman’s house on the eastern bank, then investigate the villages.
hints: The ferry is closed. The two fords lead across the island.
Scouting patrols are working in the western woods. Contact them to gain reinforcements; ordinary recruitment is unavailable.
Explored ground stays visible. Capturing a village lights it, but surviving spiders can take it back.

intro.speaker: Nera
intro.text: The other bank is completely dark. We need to reach the ferryman and find out why.

intro.speaker: Ivo
intro.text: The ferry is closed. We can cross by the island fords. Our scouts should still be watching the woods.

victory.speaker: Nera
victory.text: The lanterns are burning again. Take the eastern road—we need to find out where they took everyone.

debrief: The patrol reached the ferryman and secured the eastern villages.
